title: Most Champions League hat-tricks
brief: Name the ten players with the most Champions League hat-tricks (three or more goals in a game) since 1992/93. Tenth place is shared by everyone on two.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26, group or league stage onwards

notes.Raul: Raul scored one Champions League hat-trick.
notes.Thierry Henry: Thierry Henry scored one Champions League hat-trick.
notes.Mohamed Salah: Mohamed Salah scored one Champions League hat-trick.
notes.Vinicius Junior: Vinicius Junior scored one Champions League hat-trick.

sources: https://match.uefa.com/v5/matches?competitionId=1&seasonYear=<year> (UEFA match data with every scorer, 1992/93 to 2025/26)
checks: Wikipedia lists 173 hat-tricks to 9 September 2026; two of them (Demirovic and Ferran Torres) came in 2026/27, leaving 171 to the end of 2025/26. Counting three or more goals per player per game from UEFA match events gives the same 171 and the same count for every player above. Fifteen players have two: Marco Simone, Andriy Shevchenko, Ruud van Nistelrooy, Andy Cole, Michael Owen, Roy Makaay, Didier Drogba, Adriano, Samuel Eto'o, Roberto Soldado, Sergio Aguero, Olivier Giroud, Harry Kane, Gabriel Jesus, Erling Haaland.
